_doc: The evidence workbook (J4検証資料(...)_<Excel_NAME>.xlsx), read off the delivered sample (QJDSWM39): sheet names, labels, font, highlight patterns, and where the DF / Jenkins boxes go.

df._doc: DF window 1133 x 429 shows exactly 16 data lines (the sample evidence); a file with more lines gets a second capture after Ctrl+End with the wave between. Boxes on the END picture: the last line number (found as the last band of dark ink in the line-number strip) and the 同一内容 cell of the status bar (bottom-right).

share._doc: how human.share puts the Teams reply on the clipboard: rich = text + pictures in ONE paste (HTML + RTF); sequence = text, then each picture, one paste each. Switch in <WorkDir>/ebi.local.json { "layout": { "share": { "mode": "sequence" } } } if Teams drops the pictures of a rich paste.
